symptom: AGENTS.md and hooks invoked Docker Compose service app, but compose.yaml defined only shikishi.
decision: Add an app service backed by a Docker development target containing the project and dev quality tools.
rationale: Make the documented and hook-driven Docker quality commands executable without changing the production service.

symptom: A style LoRA alone could not reliably reproduce an untrained minor character or a supplied pose.
evidence: LoRA caption audit: 1837 ixy_style captions, 0 hotarugusa captions
decision: Keep ixy_style as a style adapter; add validated private reference ingestion, img2img for composition, and on-demand IP-Adapter for identity. Defer ControlNet until an 8 GB VRAM A/B test shows img2img is insufficient, and defer multiple-LoRA character adapters until a lawful character dataset exists.
rationale: Separates style, identity, and pose controls while keeping the working RTX 4060 path stable and avoiding unsupported claims of exact character reproduction.

symptom: Diffusers applied the requested revision to IP-Adapter weights but did not propagate it to the CLIP image encoder, so a fixed-revision offline load failed.
decision: Pin h94/IP-Adapter revision 018e402774aeeddd60609b4ecdb7e298259dc729, use safetensors, explicitly load and register the image encoder from the same revision, and record artifact SHA-256 values.
rationale: Prevents silent version mixing and permits verified offline reuse of the persistent model cache.

symptom: IP-Adapter inference failed on an RTX 4060 after the base pipeline consumed 7869 MiB, then failed again because Diffusers 0.39 could not convert SlicedAttnProcessor without a slice size.
evidence: CUDA memory 7869 MiB used / 89 MiB free
decision: Move the pipeline to CPU before loading IP-Adapter, disable attention slicing for adapter conversion, and enable model CPU offload after all adapter modules are registered.
rationale: Keeps peak VRAM within 8 GB while preserving a working reference-conditioned inference path.

symptom: A normal generation immediately after IP-Adapter failed because the pipeline remained on CPU while its generator targeted CUDA; the first Plus ViT-H load also paired a 1280-dimensional adapter with the 1664-dimensional SDXL image encoder.
evidence: Cannot generate a cpu tensor from a generator of type cuda
mat1 and mat2 shapes cannot be multiplied (514x1664 and 1280x1280)
decision: After each reference job, detach the image encoder and restore the pipeline to CUDA with attention slicing; configure adapter and encoder subfolders independently; use Plus ViT-H with models/image_encoder and a default scale of 0.35.
rationale: Restores repeatable mixed reference/non-reference operation and uses the encoder architecture required by the selected Plus weights. A/B outputs retained more character details without the standard adapter's white-out at moderate scales.

symptom: Loading Plus and Plus Face adapters simultaneously restarted the 8 GB GPU container, while long combined prompts placed pose instructions beyond the SDXL text encoder limit.
evidence: 101 prompt tokens exceeded the 77-token CLIP limit
decision: Store appearance, face, and pose as separate request roles; place the short pose prompt before appearance text; run appearance generation and weak face refinement sequentially, fully unloading the first adapter before loading Plus Face.
rationale: Uses reference images for missing character details without simultaneous adapter memory pressure, and preserves pose conditioning inside the effective prompt window.

symptom: An SDXL img2img pipeline created with from_pipe mixed float32 latent/prompt components with float16 IP-Adapter UNet processors, causing reciprocal Half/Float matrix multiplication failures.
decision: After loading IP-Adapter modules and before installing CPU-offload hooks, cast the complete composed pipeline to the configured inference dtype. Preserve full exception tracebacks in structured logs.
rationale: Casting only the projection or UNet changed which side mismatched; casting the whole composition maintains one inference dtype across shared and newly attached modules.

symptom: The 512px reference-conditioned result had chibi proportions and simplified clothing, while face refinement was suspected of causing the degradation.
decision: Keep weak face refinement, add an opt-out standard-proportions conditioning flag, and expose draft/standard/high quality presets with an effective pose-step warning.
rationale: The face-refinement A/B was nearly identical, while 1024px and 30 steps restored normal proportions and substantially more clothing detail. This targets the measured cause without changing model weights.

symptom: Repeatedly selecting the same generated image as a reference created duplicate preserved source and metadata records.
evidence: same generated PNG posted twice returned different IDs before the change
post-change ID b96d5cbfad044f519b466bcf519e590b returned twice with metadata count remaining 6
decision: Serialize reference writes and reuse a valid normalized record with the same source SHA-256.
rationale: Makes retries and double taps idempotent while still allowing the same reference ID to appear twice in a request with different appearance and face roles.

symptom: The bounded generation queue retained cancelled capacity, IP-Adapter load failures could leave shared Diffusers modules mutated, application typing excluded runtime modules, and Kaggle accepted trainer exit status without verifying its artifact.
evidence: Docker test and production targets built successfully
decision: Use condition-protected pending state with bounded terminal retention, isolate the queue behind protocols, rollback and evict shared pipelines after adapter failures, type-check all runtime modules, and bind Kaggle resume/artifact acceptance to explicit identities and checksums.
rationale: These changes make state transitions and completion evidence explicit while keeping GPU libraries at an integration boundary and preserving lazy model loading.

symptom: A 512px request using appearance IP-Adapter followed by face-refinement IP-Adapter exhausted the Docker Linux engine memory budget; the first run exited 137 and a same-request encoder-reuse experiment made the engine unresponsive.
decision: Roll back the unproven encoder-reuse experiment and retain the verified single-stage appearance-reference path. Do not claim dual-stage face refinement is supported on the current Docker memory allocation.
rationale: The single-stage request completed and saved a reproducible image, while both dual-stage attempts destabilized the container or engine. A future fix should use a single denoising stage or a larger verified memory budget.
